description: Optional first step for a vague page request (e.g. 'make me a website for my barbershop'). Returns at most one round of questions to ask together: the name, the main visitor action AND where it goes (WhatsApp number with country code, booking/order link, phone or address), and must-have facts. Skip it when the request already has a name and the main action's destination — call page_create_from_brief directly. Call at most once per request; if the user gave a public link, read it yourself or use source_import instead. Does not create a page.

businessName.description: Only include if the user already provided the business or project name.

businessType.description: Business category inferred from the user's words, such as hamburger restaurant or dental clinic.

locale.description: Preferred content locale if obvious from the conversation.

originalRequest.description: The user's original page-creation request, copied verbatim when available.

primaryGoal.description: The main visitor action if known, such as book, call, WhatsApp, buy, or leave a lead.

sourceHandle.description: Public social handle provided by the user.

sourceUrl.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS source URL provided by the user, such as a business website or link-in-bio page. Protected platforms (social networks, maps, paywalls) require client-side browsing or pasted details instead.
